title: Training Q&A: Courtesy Late-Fee Waivers and the Storage Unit Catch-Up Amount (Bluegate AutoPay Authorization)
content:
**The rule.** On a storage unit authorization under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, the unit catch-up amount leaves out a fee the tenant was excused from: **the second late fee**, where the latest courtesy late-fee waiver was credited against the returned period's second late fee; **the late fee**, where it was credited against the returned period's first late fee; and **nothing** otherwise. The amount left out is subtracted.

**Q. Which waiver is read?** The latest courtesy late-fee waiver credit on the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement ledger, by entry date. Only that one is read; an earlier waiver is not.

**Q. How is it tied to the returned period?** Through the fee entry the waiver credit references: its fee type (late fee or second late fee) and its period, which must be the returned due date (the agreement's oldest unpaid due date).

**Q. What figure is left out?** For a waived second late fee, the second late fee of the agreement's unit class ($15.00 on Bluegate Drive-Up Standard, Interior Standard and Climate Controlled; $20.00 on Climate Plus; $25.00 on Premier Climate Suite and Wine & Collectibles Vault). For a waived first late fee, the late fee counted in the unit catch-up amount.

**Q. The latest waiver references a late fee of a later period, and an older waiver references the returned period's second late fee. What is left out?** Nothing: the latest waiver does not reference the returned period.

**Q. The latest waiver references the returned period's second late fee on a Bluegate Climate Plus unit (hypothetical).** $20.00 is left out.

**Q. No courtesy late-fee waiver is on the ledger.** Nothing is left out.

| Latest courtesy waiver references | Period of that fee is the returned due date | Left out |
|---|---|---|
| A second late fee | Yes | Second late fee |
| A late fee | Yes | Late fee |
| Either | No | Nothing |
| No waiver on record | — | Nothing |
